name: Kansas
agencyName: Kansas Department of Revenue, Division of Vehicles

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: After four failed knowledge exams, wait 6 months from the most recent failure before restarting
retake.retakeFee: $1.50 for a reexamination within 6 months; $3 abandonment fee after 6 months

gdl.nightCurfew: No driving 9 p.m.-5 a.m. under a restricted/GDL license except to/from work, school, or religious activities
gdl.passengerLimits: No more than one non-sibling passenger under 18 while restricted

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity/lawful presence (e.g. U.S. birth certificate or passport)
Proof of Social Security number (Social Security card or SSN document)
Proof of any name change (e.g. marriage certificate) if applicable
process.realIdNotes: A REAL ID-compliant credential requires proof of lawful presence/identity, a Social Security number document, and proof of Kansas residency; a non-compliant (standard) license remains available.
process.permitFee: $10 total ($2 issuance + $8 photo); initial examination is $3 when testing is required
process.licenseFee: New regular Class C with testing: $29 ages 21-64, $23 over 64; under-21 Class C or M row totals $51 and includes a $20 motorcycle fee, so a Class C-only under-21 total is not unambiguously stated on the chart
process.visionStandard: At least 20/40 in one eye, with or without corrective lenses, for an unrestricted license

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: No numeric point system; suspension can follow 3 or more moving-violation convictions within 12 months
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane, or slow down if you cannot safely move, for stopped emergency, tow, and highway-maintenance vehicles with flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph when posted (varies by posted sign)

references.citation: Kansas Department of Revenue, Kansas Driving Handbook

verifyNote: The official handbook is revised February 2022 and confirms 25 questions with an 80% passing score (20 correct), ages, and GDL rules. The official fee chart is dated May 2023 and confirms permit, test, and age-banded adult Class C fees, but its under-21 'Class C or M' row bundles a $20 motorcycle fee and does not unambiguously state the Class C-only total. The state-level school-zone 20 mph summary also remains unconfirmed by the handbook.
